what: A laser marks a target and a laser-guided bomb steers toward the spot; the BOLT-117 was combat-evaluated in 1968, followed by the Paveway kits.

laser: Chemical oxygen iodine laser (COIL) plus two solid-state lasers
what: A modified 747 tested against boosting missiles at Edwards AFB, 2002-2012; retired to storage in 2012.

use: Shipboard laser weapon with dazzler and surveillance (HELIOS)
what: Lockheed Martin system on USS Preble; fired at a drone in FY2024 testing.

laser: High-power laser (system disputed: Lite Beam, Iron Beam-M)
what: Israel said about 40 drones were downed in 2025; the Ministry of Defense said no Iron Beam components were involved.

use: Laser air defense against rockets, mortars and drones (Iron Beam)
laser: High-power laser (Rafael; laser by Elbit Systems)
what: Declared operational September 2025; first combat-ready system delivered to the IDF in December 2025.
